name: Nikoo Homes 9
address: Survey Nos. 120 and 121, Hoovinayakanahalli Village, Jala Hobli, Bengaluru North, Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka
description: Nikoo Homes 9 is a multi-format residential development marketed for Bagalur, with a masterplan combining gardens, recreation and social spaces. Published formats include studios, apartments with additional study areas, lofts and sky villas. The planned community includes sports areas, a shopping plaza and Black Swan Club spaces, creating a wider neighbourhood proposition alongside individual homes.
